profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, traded under the ticker DXC and identified by CIK 0001688568. The website listed for it is dexus.com. The held record shows no products tracked, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for the company, and it records a litigation exposure count of 152 in Virginia.

The text harvested from that website does not describe DXC. It describes Dexus, which presents itself as an Australasian infrastructure and real estate fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and which identifies itself as Dexus (ASX: DXS). Among the items on the page are Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching its full height of more than 180 metres, described as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, and a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds. The page also carries standard disclaimers that the information may change without notice, that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance, and that the material is general information only.

Nothing in the harvested site text describes AI products or an AI position for either name, and the held facts list no products for DXC Technology Co. The material available is therefore thin on the company's own business, and the site content and the company record do not match.
